That's My Brain is a game that's all about speed and reaction time. But despite its challenging nature, the game is deceptively easy to pick up, making it an excellent choice for players of all ages and skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a fun, casual experience, That's My Brain is sure to provide countless hours of entertainment.

sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, That's My Brain is a simple yet engaging game that's all about speed and reaction time. As the football player, you'll need to navigate through a vertically scrolling field, avoiding zombies and collecting brains in a never-ending quest for survival. The gameplay is divided into three main components: movement, jumping, and dodging. Movement is handled via the keyboard or mouse, allowing you to control your character's movement and jumps. Jumping is a crucial aspect of the game, as you'll need to time your jumps perfectly to avoid zombies and reach those hard-to-access brains. Dodging is a more advanced mechanic, allowing you to quickly change direction and avoid incoming zombies. The more brains you collect, the more upgrades you'll unlock, allowing you to enhance your character's abilities and take on even more challenging levels.

One of the most impressive aspects of That's My Brain is its endless level generator. With a vast array of obstacles, enemies, and power-ups, each level is unique and challenging in its own way. The game's AI is also surprisingly robust, making each level feel fresh and exciting. The zombies may seem simple at first, but they're actually quite cunning, adapting to your playing style and becoming increasingly difficult to avoid as you progress through the levels.

That's My Brain also features a variety of power-ups and upgrades, which can be collected throughout the levels. These power-ups range from basic items like health boosts and speed increases to more advanced items like invincibility and extra brains. The more brains you collect, the more upgrades you'll unlock, allowing you to enhance your character's abilities and take on even more challenging levels.
